title: Ukukhuthala
author: Lumni
content:
# Ukukhuthala

Kwakukhona umfana okuthiwa nguBongani owayehlala emzini omncane. Wayethanda isikole, kodwa indlela eya esikoleni yayinde futhi inzima. Kwakufanele ahambe amakhilomitha amathathu nsuku zonke.

Ngenye intwasahlobo, umama kaBongani wagula. Wathi: "Bongani, angikwazi ukuphakela ukudla kwakho namuhla. Kumele uhambe ungadlile."

UBongani wakhumbula ukuthi uthisha wakhe wayemtshela: "Ukukhuthala yisihluthulelo sempumelelo. Ungaze udelele!

Ngakho uBongani wahamba waya esikoleni. Indlela yayinde, isisu salamba. Kodwa waqhubeka.

Ngenkathi efika esikoleni, uthisha wakhe uNkk. Ndlovu wambona ekhathala. "Bongani, kwenzenjani? Uyagula?"

"Mama, akukho ukudla ekhaya. Umama ugula."

UNkk. Ndlovu wamhlabela isinkwa nobisi. Wathi: "Ungalahli ithemba, Bongani. Ukukhuthala kwakho kuzakusiza."

Emva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, umama kaBongani waphila. UBongani akazange aphose itawula. Wafunda kanzima, waphumelela izivivinyo zakhe. Waba ngumfundi ophumelela kakhulu esikoleni.

Ngomnyaka olandelayo, uBongani wathola umklomelo wesikole. Wathi enkulumweni yakhe: "Ukukhuthala akusho ukuze ungaze wehluleke. Kusho ukuqhubeka noma kunjani."

## Izifundo

1. **Ukukhuthala** — Ungayeki nanoma izinto zinzima. Qhubeka uphambili.
2. **Ithemba** — Ungalahli ithemba. Izinto ziyakuthuthuka.
3. **Ukusebenza kanzima** — Umsebenzi onzima ukhokhela ngempumelelo.
